title: ADL Danish
notes: Texts of the Archive for Danish Literature (ADL), a collaboration between the Det Danske Sprog- og Litteraturselskab (DSL) and the Royal Danish Library (KB), published in the public GitHub repository kb-dk/public-adl-text-sources. The corpus comprises 498 volumes (165,512 pages) of Danish literature, all encoded in TEI; the repository contains the roughly two-thirds of pages that have been OCR'd and encoded, one TEI-XML file per volume under texts/. The repository also documents the encoding practices, offers XSLT scripts to extract single works, and accepts contributions by pull request; it was last pushed to in August 2026. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
